slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use `jasmine.createSpyObj` for quick mocks

`const spyObj = jasmine.createSpyObj('Name', ['method1', 'method2']);` creates a mock with controllable methods. Great for dependencies.

quizData.question: You should always use the real HttpClient in unit tests to catch real server errors.
quizData.explanation: Unit tests should be fast and isolated. Mock HttpClient to avoid real network calls.
